newsitem.title: HUNGARY: EBRD grants $50 mln subordinated loan to OTP.
newsitem.headline: EBRD grants $50 mln subordinated loan to OTP.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) is to provide a $50 million, 10-year subordinated loan for Hungary's biggest commercial bank, OTP, EBRD said on Thursday.

"With over 30 percent of the country's banking assets, OTP plays an important role within the banking system and is a significant source of funding for the enterprise sector," David Hexter, deputy vice president for EBRD, said in a statement.
"The project increases OTP's capacity as a financial intermediary and enables it to serve its corporate clients more effectively."

The project aims to enable OTP to expand its business activities, including its private sector loan portfolio, while meeting the prudential requirements of both the National Bank of Hungary and the Bank for International Settlements, it said.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange OTP stocks stood at 2,830 forints, up 110, at 1047 GMT. By this time it had a huge turnover of almost 180,000 stocks.
